scope: Source-checked semantic mapping pilot; no power or representativeness claim

checks.criterion: Teacher expectancy on pupil IQ distinguished from writing and general achievement
Positive standardized effect means higher IQ in expectancy-designated group
Use supplied yi without applying Bangert raw-di correction
Use supplied vi, not equal-arm reconstruction or rounded sei squared
Unequal n1i and n2i preclude assuming equal arms
Weeks denotes contact before expectancy induction, not intervention duration
19 rows distinguished from source title18 experiments without arbitrary deletion
Repeated author/year is insufficient to infer independent or duplicate cohorts
Effect and moderator provenance from1985 and1984 distinguished
Intercept-only REML does not reproduce mixed-effects capped-weeks model
Numerical reproduction is conditional on dependence/variance assumptions, not a scientific verdict
Crop SMD computation cannot be reported as kg/ha by relabeling
Inconsistent crop record counts need data/version/unit-of-analysis reconciliation
Multiarm/network analysis cannot be replaced by independent intercept-only engine
Hold unverified crop quantitative claim and identify missing evidence
Fresh mission purpose and authority remain separate from prior artifact success
Preserve source evidence/coordinate and do not invent absent measurements

strict_packet_acceptance: All18 checks, without material contradictory assertion
adjudication: Root compares saved outputs to unchanged primary-source files; no model self-grade is decisive
